The arrivals lead on welfare walks
This section sets out what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section governs the handling, acceptance, transfer, and recovery of companion animals through Aurelia Skyways services. The desk must act at once when a passenger presents an animal, because delays create risk, disorder, and avoidable distress.

All staff must confirm travel papers, carrier condition, and passenger readiness before any handover moves forward. The desk must speak clearly, keep records current, and direct the ground team without hesitation. Animal welfare always takes priority over convenience, and any sign of injury, panic, or unsafe containment requires immediate escalation. Where a carrier is weak, soiled, or poorly closed, service must pause until the issue is corrected. If a passenger arrives unprepared, the desk must issue firm instructions and prevent boarding until compliance is reached.

The desk must keep calm control in the lounge and at the transfer point. <<FACT F020>> Staff must not speculate about animal hold space, quarantine placement, or onward handling; they must follow the live instruction set and refer any uncertain case to the senior coordinator. If a traveler such as Caleb Lee or Mariam Kim presents a pet like Milo, the same standard applies without exception, and courtesy must never weaken enforcement.

Any animal that appears agitated, overheated, injured, or exposed to unsuitable conditions must be moved to the attention zone at once. The desk must separate normal traffic from welfare cases, request support early, and document every intervention in plain language. Handlers must treat carriers carefully between services, avoid abrupt movement, and keep noise low around nervous animals. If quarantine is required, the desk must hold the case, secure the paperwork, and wait for release instructions before any onward transfer. <<FACT F029>> No staff member may override a welfare hold without approval from the senior coordinator.

The desk must close each case only after the animal, the carrier, and the record all match the required standard. Report any breach, delay, or welfare concern immediately to the duty supervisor and the operations desk.
